findings.claim: Dropping address_raw before the addresses have been parsed into the new columns means the structured fields will be empty and the raw data is gone.
There is no down migration and the only recovery is a nightly backup from 03:00, so a bad run at 10:00 loses seven hours of broker edits with no rollback path.
findings.recommendation: Write a reversible migration and take a manual snapshot right before running it.

findings.claim: Adding an enum value and using it in the same transaction fails on Postgres; ADD VALUE must be committed before 'archived' can appear in an update.
Using point instead of PostGIS geography will make the planned 'nearby' module inaccurate at city scale.
